summary.text: Priscila Sousa is a Democratic state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 6th Middlesex District since January 4, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She earned a B.A. from Simmons University in 2009 and worked as a sales manager, legal secretary and legal assistant before entering the House.

paragraphs.text: Priscila Sousa earned a B.A. from Simmons University in 2009.
Her career experience includes working as a sales manager with Vivint Solar, a legal secretary with the Wagner Law Group, and a legal assistant with Foglia & Associates P.C.
She has volunteered with The Progeria Research Foundation and has served on the boards of Hoops and Homework, Amazing Things Arts Center, and Framingham FORCE.

Sousa succeeded Maria Robinson in the 6th Middlesex District seat; for 2025-2026 she was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee and the Education, Election Laws, Public Health, and Ways and Means joint committees.
